6857.de: On the right by the quay a large ship and many smaller ones. On the left the sea.

6863.d: Suvine vaade sadamale. Esiplaanil kai ääres kalalaevad. Taga, kõrgemal kaldal elumajad. Hoogne maaliline laad.
6863.de: A summer view of a harbour. In the foreground fishing boats by the quay. Behind, on higher ground, dwelling houses. A vigorous, painterly style.

6872.d: Esiplaanil järv, mille paremalt kaldalt ulatub sügavale (maali keskossa) metsaga kaetud maariba. Tagapool Lõuna-Eesti künklik maastik metsatukkade ja lookleva teega.
6872.de: In the foreground a lake, from whose right bank a strip of land covered with forest reaches deep (into the centre of the painting). Behind it the hilly landscape of South Estonia with clumps of forest and a winding road.

6876.d: Hallikassinise sünge taeva all künklik maastik mäeseljakute ja puude-põõsaste puhmastega. Keskel looklev oja kaugeneb puudemasside vahele. Summutatud hallikad värvikooskõlad, hoogne maalilaad.
6876.de: Under a greyish-blue, gloomy sky a hilly landscape with mountain ridges and clumps of trees and bushes. In the middle a winding brook recedes among masses of trees. Muted greyish colour harmonies, vigorous painting style.

6917.d: Lage lumine maastik hämaruses, keskplaanil kaks madalat maja, milledel kummalgi üks aken valgustatud.
6917.de: Open snowy landscape in twilight, in the middle ground two low houses, each with one window lit.

6918.d: Kõrged tumedad, osalt lumega kaetud mäed.
6918.de: High dark mountains, partly covered with snow.

6919.d: Kirjus ruumis akna all istuv vana naine, kann süles.
6919.de: An old woman sitting under a window in a colourful room, a jug in her lap.

6921.d: Seltskond kaetud pidulaua taga: keskel priske vanapaar, proua vasakul, prillidega härra paremal. Mõlemal pool kiitsakate meeste kujud. Kõik tumedates riietes, heledad särgid, kraed paistmas. Groteskselt lahendatud figuurid, dekoratiivne laad.
6921.de: A company at a laid festive table: a plump elderly couple in the middle, the lady on the left, a bespectacled gentleman on the right. Gaunt male figures on both sides. All dressed in dark clothes, light shirts, collars showing. Grotesquely rendered figures, decorative style.

6923.d: Noor vormikas istuv naisakt veerandpöördes paremale. Ülakeha veidi ette kummardunud, pea paremale pööratud, käed selja taga, vasak jalg põlvest kõverdatud ja tõstetud. Figuur lõigatud altpoolt põlvi. Hoogne skitseeriv maalilaad, valguse ja varjuga vormiv. Taust pruunikaskollane.
6923.de: A young shapely seated female nude turned a quarter to the right. The upper body slightly bent forward, the head turned to the right, the hands behind the back, the left leg bent at the knee and raised. The figure is cropped below the knees. A vigorous, sketchy painting style, modelling with light and shadow. The background is brownish-yellow.

6924.d: Rohelisel alusel istuv akt selgvaates, veidi pööratud paremale, pea vasakule suunatud. Parem käsi süles, vasak toetub küljel. Taust markeerib ruumi. Visandlik, hoogne kujutamisviis.
6924.de: A nude seated on a green base in side view, turned slightly to the right, head turned to the left. Right hand in the lap, left hand resting on the side. The background marks the space. Sketch-like, vigorous manner of depiction.

6925.d: Toolil istuv heledapäine noor alasti naine poolpöördes paremale, parem käsi süles, vasak toetub toolileenile. Figuur lõigatud põlvede alt. Taust markeerib ruumi, vasakul ripub roosal toolil kollane draperii.
6925.de: A fair-haired young naked woman sitting on a chair, in a half-turn to the right, right hand in her lap, left hand resting on the chair's arm. The figure is cropped below the knees. The background marks a room, on the left a yellow drapery hangs on a pink chair.

6926.d: Vormikas alasti naine selgvaates istumas, poolpöördes paremale, pea vasakule küljele suunatud. Parem jalg kõverdatud, vasak ette sirutatud. Käed toetuvad taha küljele. Taust allosas kollane, ülal pruunikashall. Lopsakas pintslitöö, kohati vormi kontuuriga markeeriv.
6926.de: A shapely nude woman seen frontally, sitting in a half-turn to the right, head turned to the left side. Right leg bent, left leg stretched forward. Hands resting behind on the side. Background yellow below, brownish-grey above. Lush brushwork, in places marking the form with contour.

6965.d: Paremal paadisild, mille ääres paate. Tagaplaanil meri. Maalitud pikkade, laiade pintslitõmmetega.
6965.de: A boat pier with boats on the right. The sea in the background. Painted with long, broad brushstrokes.

6966.d: Esiplaanil grupp raagus puid. Nende vahelt paistavad majade lumised katused.
6966.de: In the foreground, a group of bare trees. Between them, snowy roofs of houses can be seen.

6967.d: Mitmesugustest geomeetrilistest pindadest moodustub rongkäigus sammuv rahvahulk. Vasakul majad.
6967.de: A crowd walking in procession is formed from various geometric planes. Houses on the left.

6968.d: Valges mannergus kimp ultramariinsiniste õitega lilli. Maaling pastoosne.
6968.de: In a white mug a bouquet of flowers with ultramarine blue blossoms. Painted in a pastose manner.

6969.d: Sinises riietuses prillidega mehe rinnafiguur otsevaates, pea kerges pöördes vasakule.
6969.de: Chest-length figure of a man in blue clothing with glasses, frontal view, head slightly turned to the left.

6970.d: Keskel mees- ja naisfiguur, paremal ja vasakul pillimängijad. Taga keskel puu ja laululava kaar.
6970.de: In the middle a male and female figure, on the right and left musicians. Behind in the middle a tree and the arc of the song-festival stage.

6971.d: Esiplaanil kollakates toonides maapind roosade kividega. Eemal rohekassinine meri.
6971.de: In the foreground ground in yellowish tones with pink stones. In the distance a greenish-blue sea.

6972.d: Sinise taeva taustal heledates toonides kujundeid - esiplaanil horisontaalse, keskplaanil vertikaalse ülesehitusega.
6972.de: Against a blue sky background, shapes in light tones - horizontal composition in the foreground, vertical composition in the middle ground.

6973.d: Heledal lauanurgal rohekas purk kirjude lilledega. Foon hallikates-pruunikates toonides.
6973.de: On a light-coloured table corner a greenish jar with colourful flowers. Background in grey-brown tones.

6977.d: Pildil vasakul all ääres maas kuhi arbuuse. Samas vasakul valges kitlis müüja arbuusi kaalumas, tema ümber hulk inimesi - ostjaid, kõige ees punases kleidis naine valge kotiga. Paremal veoauto, millelt laaditakse maha kaste arbuusidega. Taga suur kastanipuu ja majad.
6977.de: In the picture, lower left edge, a heap of watermelons on the ground. There too, a seller in a white smock weighing a watermelon, surrounded by a number of people - buyers, in front a woman in a red dress with a white bag. On the right, a truck being unloaded of crates of watermelons. Behind, a large chestnut tree and houses.

6978.d: Roheliste, pruunide ja kollaste laikudega maalitud kaarjas rannariba ja sügavsinine merepind.
6978.de: A curved shoreline and deep blue sea surface painted with green, brown and yellow patches.

6979.d: Noormehe rinnaportree. Pea rinnale langetatud, kerges pöördes vasakule; käed vaheliti rinnal. Ilme mõtlik, endassesüvenenud. Markantne, konstruktiivne siluett en face, toonitatud külmades toonides terava kontuuriga. Foonil teravnurksed geomeetrilised kujundid. Figuur ja foon maalitud hallikais ja ookerjais toonides (figuuril detailid antud sinisega.)
6979.de: Bust portrait of a young man. Head lowered toward the chest, in a slight turn to the left; hands crossed on the chest. Expression pensive, absorbed in thought. A striking, constructive silhouette en face, toned in cold tones with a sharp contour. In the background, sharp-angled geometric shapes. The figure and background painted in greyish and ochreish tones (details on the figure given in blue).

6983.d: Hallide sirgjoonte ning hallide ja beežide värvipindadega modelleeritud keskealise naise portree otsevaates, kerges pöördes vasemale, pilk suunatud vaatajale. Ülespidiste silmanurkadega hallid mandlisilmad. Käisteta, nelinurkse dekolteega kollane kleit. Hall foon paremal õla kohal väikese kollase ning suurema beeži ristkülikuga.
6983.de: A portrait of a middle-aged woman modelled with grey straight lines and grey and beige colour surfaces, facing front, in a slight turn to the left, gaze directed at the viewer. Grey almond eyes with upturned corners. A sleeveless yellow dress with a square neckline. Grey background with a small yellow and a larger beige rectangle above the right shoulder.

6997.d: Lainepapist alusele kleebitud tekstiili ja paberitükid. Ülal paberist, beež, peaaegu ring, vasakul siidine beež ja hallikas-valge, paksem riie, paremal horisontaalselt kaks tumepruuni riide riba, tükike pitsi, rohelist ja beeži paberist pindu.
6997.de: Pieces of textile and paper glued onto a corrugated cardboard base. Above, an almost circular shape of paper, beige, on the left a silky beige and grayish-white, thicker fabric, on the right two horizontal strips of dark brown fabric, a piece of lace, patches of green and beige paper.

6998.d: Kujutise keskel kala naturaalne selgroog tumelillakal, sinakas-lillal foonil. Pool kalast kaetud rohelise, karvastatud paberiga.
6998.de: In the middle of the image the natural spine of a fish on a dark purplish, bluish-purple background. Half of the fish covered with green, textured paper.

7007.d: Kirjudes, peamiselt lillakates toonides maalitud lehtmets.
7007.de: Colourful, mainly purplish-toned painted leafy forest.

7015.d: Hallil ümmargusel laual sale tume vaas valgete nartsissidega. Foon maalitud pruunide ja ookerjate pindadena.
7015.de: A slender dark vase with white narcissi on a grey round table. Background painted as brown and ochre surfaces.

7026.d: Vaade viljapuuaiale: raagus puud piiratud tumedate kontuuridega, okste vahelt paistavad majad.
7026.de: A view of an orchard: bare trees bounded by dark contours, houses visible through the branches.

7027.d: Ümberringi hulgaliselt kastanilehti ja õisi. Nende keskel paremal sinine vaas ja vasakul punakas kann. Foon punakas-roheline.
7027.de: All around numerous chestnut leaves and blossoms. In their middle on the right a blue vase and on the left a reddish jug. The background is reddish-green.

7028.d: Tumedal taustal neli kummardavat figuuri kartulikorvidega, piiritletud musta üldistava kontuuriga.
7028.de: Four bowing figures with potato baskets against a dark background, delineated by a black generalising contour.

7029.d: Laual kaks vaasi tulpidega ja kauss. Esemed piiratud musta kontuuriga, foon rahutu.
7029.de: On the table two vases with tulips and a bowl. Objects bounded by a black contour, restless background.

7030.d: Neljanurgelisel laual pudel ja pokaal punase veiniga, pirnid ja mingi roheline taim. Maalitud pastoosselt, kontuurid musta värviga tugevalt toonitatud.
7030.de: On a four-cornered table a bottle and a goblet with red wine, pears and some green plant. Painted pastily, contours strongly accentuated with black paint.

7039.d: Heledates teravates värvitoonides ning kontrastsetes hele-tumedusastmeis olustikuliste jutustavate detailiderikas kompositsioon. Keskplaanil maali keskel roheline metsatransportöör paremast äärest keskpaigani diagonaalselt kulgevate vagunite kõrval. Paremal esiplaanil poolprofiilis paremale palke siduv mees paljastatud ülakehaga, paremal mees profiilis paremale pootshaagiga, temast paremal ja veidi eespool poolprofiilis paremale ette kummardunud mees käsimootorsaega. Vasemal äärel keskplaanil väike palgivirn, kütusepaagid ning sara. Tagaplaanil keskpaigast parema servani ning vasakul äärel maali veerandi laiuse osas mets. Vorme lihtsustav modelleerimine.
7039.de: A composition rich in narrative, genre-scene detail, in bright, sharp tones and contrasting light-dark gradations. In the middle ground, at the centre of the painting, a green forest conveyor beside wagons running diagonally from the right edge to the middle. In the right foreground, in half-profile facing right, a man with a bared upper body binding logs; to the right a man in profile facing right with a boat hook; to his right and slightly further forward, in half-profile, a man bent forward facing right with a hand-held chainsaw. On the left edge, in the middle ground, a small pile of logs, fuel tanks and a shed. In the background, from the middle to the right edge, and on the left edge over a width of a quarter of the painting, forest. Simplifying modelling of forms.

7042.d: Värvilistest geomeetrilistest kujunditest kompositsioon, milles domineerivad punane, kollane, külm roheline ja hall toon. Esiplaanil on selgemini eristatav mehe figuur ja pasunad. Mehe selja taga rahvamass lippudega. Tagaplaanil loosungite ja lippudega ehitatud majad, ülaservas tükike erksinist kevadist taevast.
7042.de: Composition of coloured geometric shapes, in which red, yellow, cold green and grey tones dominate. In the foreground a man's figure and trumpets are more clearly distinguishable. Behind the man's back a crowd with flags. In the background buildings built with slogans and flags, in the upper edge a piece of bright blue spring sky.

7043.d: Geomeetriliste kujundite ja joonte kombineerimisel saadud kompositsioon, kasutatud külmi siniseid ja rohelisi toone, halli, kollast ja ookrit. Silmapiiril tugev tumesinine aktsent kõrgust ja kaugust rõhutamas, all esiplaanil järvesilm.
7043.de: A composition obtained by combining geometric shapes and lines, using cold blue and green tones, grey, yellow and ochre. On the horizon a strong dark blue accent emphasising height and distance, at the bottom in the foreground a patch of lake water.

7045.d: Linnavaade, maalitud vaatega ülalt alla katustele, mille tagant paistavad kirikute ja linnamüüri tornid. Esiplaanil õu nelja raagus puuga, lõuendi ülaosas kitsas riba halli taevast. Maalitud sinakashallides toonides mõne üksiku pruuni aktsendiga.
7045.de: A city view, painted with a view from above down onto the roofs, behind which the towers of churches and the town wall appear. In the foreground a yard with four bare trees, at the top of the canvas a narrow strip of grey sky. Painted in bluish-grey tones with a few isolated brown accents.

7046.d: Esiplaanil sinine tõstuk. Sellest ülalpool autod ja kaubavagunid, paremal paat. Keskplaanis vasakul suure kraana alumine osa, paremal suur laev kai ääres. Ülaservas hooneid ja hele taevas. Joonte ja väikeste värvipindade geometriseerimine vaheldub maalilisusega.
7046.de: In the foreground a blue lift/hoist. Above it cars and freight wagons, on the right a boat. In the middle ground, on the left, the lower part of a large crane, on the right a large ship at the quay. At the top edge buildings and a bright sky. The geometrisation of lines and small colour surfaces alternates with painterliness.

7047.d: Esiplaanil hallides pükstes ja särgis tööline masinat lükkamas. Temast vasakul ja all servas masinad, paremal suur paberirull. Pildi ülaosas vabriku sisseseade, kraana punast tala tõstmas, viis inimfiguuri. Hallides, pruunides ja rohelistes toonides.
7047.de: In the foreground a worker in grey trousers and shirt pushing a machine. To his left and at the lower edge machines, on the right a large paper roll. In the upper part of the picture factory equipment, a crane lifting a red beam, five human figures. In grey, brown and green tones.

7049.d: Hallis ülikonnas mees toolil istumas, mõtlik näoilme, käed ristatud sõrmedega põlvedel. Helehall foon. Käed, nägu, püksisäär ja pintsaku varrukad hoolikalt läbi maalitud. Valdavalt hallid ja pruunid toonid.
7049.de: A man in a grey suit sitting on a chair, pensive expression, hands crossed with fingers on his knees. Light grey background. Hands, face, trouser leg and jacket sleeves carefully painted through. Predominantly grey and brown tones.

7050.d: Istuv heledapäine naisakt, käed diivanile peopesadega toetatud, lopsakas figuur. Foonil paremal aken, vasakul sein pildiga. Hallides, pruunides ja kollastes toonides, pinnad jaotatud üksikuteks värvikildudeks.
7050.de: A seated fair-haired female nude, hands resting palms-down on the sofa, a voluptuous figure. In the background, a window on the right, a wall with a picture on the left. In grey, brown and yellow tones, the surfaces divided into individual patches of colour.

7051.d: Esiplaanil kolm mehefiguuri: vasakpoolsel hallipäisel ja hallis riides mehel käes mõõdulatt, keskmisel siniste pükstega mehel kott üle õla, parempoolsel peas nokkmüts ja jalas hallid püksid. Tagaplaanil raskesti eristatavate üksikasjadega maastik. Kõik pinnad killustatud väikesteks geomeetrilisteks kujunditeks ja hallide, pruunide, siniste, kollaste, roheliste toonidega täidetud.
7051.de: In the foreground three male figures: the man on the left, grey-haired and dressed in grey, holds a measuring rod, the man in the middle, wearing blue trousers, has a bag over his shoulder, the man on the right wears a peaked cap and grey trousers. In the background a landscape with details that are difficult to distinguish. All surfaces fragmented into small geometric shapes and filled with tones of grey, brown, blue, yellow, and green.

7052.d: Esiplaanil seadeldis õunte ja kannuga natüürmordi maalimiseks. Paremal ja vasakul servas molbertid, ülemises servas mitu erinevas skemaatilisuse astmes antud figuuri, keskel üksik inimene molberti taga. Kogu maali ulatuses on joonistus nähtaval, näod ja esemed vaid tükati värviga kaetud, rõhutatult lõpetamata.
7052.de: In the foreground an arrangement for painting a still life of apples and a jug. Molberts (easels) at the right and left edges, at the top edge several figures given in varying degrees of schematisation, in the centre a single person behind an easel. Throughout the entire extent of the painting the drawing is visible, faces and objects are only partly covered with paint, emphatically unfinished.

7054.d: Esiplaanil kollased, pooleldi raagus, väga skemaatiliselt antud puud. Tagaplaanil vanalinna siluett paari kirikutorniga. Maalitud etüüdilikult, pintslilööke ja püstjooni rõhutades. Hallikaspruun üldkoloriit, üksikute roheliste värvilaikudega.
7054.de: In the foreground, yellow, half-bare, very schematically rendered trees. In the background, the silhouette of the old town with a couple of church towers. Painted in an étude-like manner, emphasising brushstrokes and vertical lines. Greyish-brown overall colour scheme, with isolated patches of green.

7055.d: Lühikeste juuste ja sirge ninajoonega tütarlapse kolmveerandportree otsevaates ja istuvas asendis. Seljas revääridega jakk ja seelik, käed kokkupandult põlvedel. Maalitud geometriseeritult, värvilised tahud moodustavad struktuuri, mis üldistub kujutiseks. Foonil vasakul kiirtevihku meenutavad tahud, paremal suuremad helepruunid pinnad. Kasutatud halle, külmi rohelisi ja ookritoone, kohati ka paberit peale kleebitud, kohati ka riiet.
7055.de: A three-quarter portrait, front-facing and seated, of a girl with short hair and a straight nose line. Wearing a jacket with lapels and a skirt, hands folded on the knees. Painted in a geometricised manner, coloured facets form a structure that is generalised into an image. In the background on the left facets reminiscent of a bundle of rays, on the right larger light brown surfaces. Greys, cold greens and ochre tones are used, in places paper is also glued on, in places also fabric.

7056.d: Naise kolmveerandportree otsevaates: jalg üle põlve asetatud, käed kokkupandult põlvedel. Figuur antud geomeetriliselt, tahkudena, mis moodustavad ruumilise struktuuri. Kollakaspruunides, lillades ja hallides toonides. Foon hall.
7056.de: Three-quarter portrait of a woman in direct view: leg placed over the knee, hands folded on the knees. The figure is rendered geometrically, in facets, forming a spatial structure. In yellowish-brown, purple and grey tones. Background grey.

7057.dm: kõrgus: 78.1 cm (km); laius: 65.2 cm; kõrgus: 79.8 cm; laius: 63.0 cm (km)
7057.d: Valkjashallides, pruunides toonides geometriseerivalt lahendatud ateljee vaade. Paremal molbert kireva paletiga, vasakul lauanurk. Tagapool ja seinal vasakul värvikamad maalid.
7057.de: A geometrically resolved view of a studio in whitish-grey and brown tones. On the right an easel with a colourful palette, on the left the corner of a table. Behind and on the wall on the left, more colourful paintings.

7058.d: Heleda draperiiga punakaspruunil foonil paremal natüürmordi seadeldis piimanõu, kruusi ja kannuga, põllulilled anumates. Vasakul molbertile paigutatud osa lõuendist, mille paremasse nurka markeeritud kruusi kujutis. Maal kohati akvarellilikult õhuke, värve tugevasti lahustatud.
7058.de: Against a light drapery on a reddish-brown background, on the right a still-life arrangement of a milk vessel, a mug and a jug, field flowers in vessels. On the left, a portion of the canvas placed on an easel, in the right corner of which the depiction of a mug is marked. The painting is in places watercolour-like thin, the paints heavily diluted.

7059.d: Esiplaani keskel kõrge, haruliste okstega puu, kroomroheline puukroon heleda taeva taustal. Tagapool madalad pruunikashallid taluhooned.
7059.de: In the centre of the foreground a tall tree with branching boughs, chromium-green treetop against a light sky background. Behind it, low brownish-grey farm buildings.

7060.d: Väikese kapi pealsel klaaspurk mitmesuguste õitsvate taimede ja rohtudega. Purk taimedega peegeldub vastu kapipealsel. Foon beež, kohati papi pind värvidega katmata. Taimede taha foonile on pruuni värviga markeeritud nelinurk, siia-sinna on foonile tõmmatud püstjooni. Valitsevad pruunid, rohelised ja sinised värvitoonid, lopsakas maalimisviis.
7060.de: On top of a small cabinet a glass jar with various flowering plants and herbs. The jar with the plants is reflected on the cabinet top. The background is beige, in places the surface of the cardboard is left uncovered with paint. Behind the plants a rectangle is marked on the background in brown paint, and here and there vertical lines are drawn on the background. Brown, green and blue tones predominate, a lush manner of painting.

7061.d: Suur kompositsioon esiplaanilt sügavusse suunduvate lillelettidega, mida ülalt varjavad kirevad päevavarjud. Lillelettide vahel suures dekoratiivses üldistuses antud inimesed. Lettidel lillekimbud, gladioolide puhmad, tagaplaanil uusehitused ja kraana. Taevas helesinine, ere päikesevalgus annab kõigele teravad varjud. Figuuridest esiplaanil tütarlaps ja naine ning paremal valge kotiga naine ning mees. Maalitud kirevate, dekoratiivsete värvipindadena.
7061.de: A large composition with flower stalls receding from the foreground into the depth, shaded above by colourful parasols. Between the flower stalls, people rendered in a large decorative generalisation. On the stalls, bouquets of flowers, clumps of gladioli, in the background new buildings and a crane. The sky is light blue, bright sunlight casting sharp shadows on everything. Among the figures in the foreground, a girl and a woman, and on the right a woman with a white bag and a man. Painted as colourful, decorative colour surfaces.

7062.d: Värvilise joontesäbruga antud lillekimp. Foon vasakult hall, paremal koobaltsinine, erepunane, allosas punakaspruun ja akvarellilikult sulav. Maalikiht õhuke, kohati papp värviga katmata.
7062.de: A bouquet of flowers rendered with colourful curling lines. Background grey on the left, cobalt blue and bright red on the right, reddish-brown at the bottom and blending in a watercolour-like manner. The paint layer is thin, the cardboard in places left uncovered by paint.

7063.d: Õrna värvikihiga, akvarellilikult, peamisi detaile markeerivalt antud tänavapilt. Keskel pildi sügavusse suunduv tänav rohelise auto ja pruuni, kuuri meenutava majaga vasakul. Paremal hele kolmekorruseline, punakaspruuni katusega maja, mille aknad ja uksed värviliste joontega tähistatud. Maja ees roheline sõiduauto. Silmapiiril elektri- ja telefoniposte, puuderohelust. Taevas helehall, üksikute helesiniste laikudega. Papp suures osas värviga katmata.
7063.de: A street scene rendered with a thin layer of colour, in a watercolour-like manner, marking the main details. In the centre, a street receding into the depth of the picture, with a green car and a brown house resembling a shed on the left. On the right, a light-coloured three-storey house with a reddish-brown roof, whose windows and doors are marked with coloured lines. In front of the house, a green motor car. On the horizon, electricity and telephone poles, greenery of trees. The sky is light grey, with isolated light blue patches. The cardboard is largely left uncovered with paint.

7064.d: Õhukesel värvikihil ja joontemängul põhinev lillekompositsioon. Pastelsel vanaroosal, hallil, ookerkollasel foonil virtuoosse joonekäsitlusega lillekimp kirevais toonides.
7064.de: A floral composition based on a thin layer of paint and play of lines. On a pastel old-rose, grey, ochre-yellow background a bouquet of flowers in vivid tones rendered with virtuoso linework.

7065.d: Esiplaanilt kaarega pildi sügavusse suunduv tänav, mida kahelt poolt palistavad puud. Tänaval vasakul rida vanamoelisi sõidukeid, paremal suur käru. Keset tänavat üks jalgrattur ja tänavat ületav inimene. Vasakul tänava servas ülestõstetud tõkkepuu ning rida maju. Taevas helesinine. Maalikiht väga õhuke, kohati aluspappi paljaks jättev, maalimisviis etüüdlik, toonid pastelsed.
7065.de: A street curving from the foreground into the depth of the picture, lined on both sides by trees. On the street to the left a row of old-fashioned vehicles, on the right a large cart. In the middle of the street a cyclist and a person crossing the street. On the left edge of the street a raised barrier pole and a row of houses. The sky light blue. The paint layer very thin, in places leaving the underlying cardboard bare, the manner of painting sketch-like, the tones pastel.

7066.d: Paremas servas suur punane muna meenutav geomeetriline kujund, mille alumine parem osa läheb üle täisnurkseks. Muna vasakpoolses osas suur valge laik. Kujund toetub mustale pinnale, foon sidrunikollane.

7067.d: Hallid, punased, lillad ja mustad geomeetrilised kujundid ja neid kompositsiooniks organiseerivad jooned all vasakus nurgas, foon vasakul servas ja ülal kollastes toonides.

7068.d: Nurgelistest mitmevärvilistest geomeetrilistest kujunditest peaaegu abstraktne kompositsioon, milles kohati aimata inimfiguure.

7071.d: Tihedatest, küllastunud toonides abstraktsetest värvilaikudest kompositsioon. Beežikashalli taeva all aimatav kupliline maastik. Vasakul summutatud pruunikates toonides, paremal nõlv erksamas, heledamas gammas. Esiplaanil osa veekogust. Jõuline pintslikäik, küllalt pastoosne maal.
7071.de: A composition of dense, saturated abstract colour patches. Under a beige-grey sky, a domed landscape is suggested. On the left in muted brownish tones, on the right a slope in a brighter, lighter range. In the foreground part of a body of water. Vigorous brushwork, a rather pastose painting.

7074.d: Merepiir jagab kahvatu taeva ja liivaranna pildipinnal põigiti pooleks. Esiplaanil hoogsate laiade tõmmetega markeeritud beežikaspruun kallas, triibuna järgnev rohekassinine meri. Silmapiir pisut kaarjas.
7074.de: The sea horizon divides the pale sky and the sandy beach diagonally across the picture surface. In the foreground a beige-brown shore marked with vigorous broad strokes, followed by a strip of greenish-blue sea. The horizon is slightly curved.

7075.d: Kollase, punase, musta, halli ja sinise tooniga värvilaikudest kompositsioon. Peen joontesõrestik jagab pinnad kohati geomeetriliselt selgeteks kujunditeks. Paremas alumises nurgas punane ruut, vasak alumine neljandik valdavalt neutraalne hall pind.

7076.d: Ülaltvaade poolabstraktsele maastikule Tallinna panoraamiga. Ligi pool alumisest maaliosast kujutab kirgast kollase-rohelise-pruuni, üksteise sisse hajuvate värvilaikudega pinda. Selle kohal katuseviile, torne heleda mere ja hallide pilvetriipudega taeva taustal.
7076.de: A bird's-eye view of a semi-abstract landscape with a panorama of Tallinn. Nearly half of the lower part of the painting depicts a bright surface of yellow-green-brown colour patches diffusing into one another. Above it roof gables, towers against the background of a light sea and a sky with grey cloud stripes.

7077.d: Kahvatusinise taeva taustale markeeritud hõreda lehestikuga puud. Tüvede taga silmapiiril paistab pastellroheline mets. Keskpäevane valgus muudab toonid õrnaks. Maalikiht õhuke, laseb aluspinnal läbi kumada.
7077.de: Trees with sparse foliage marked against a pale blue sky background. Behind the trunks, on the horizon, a pastel green forest is visible. The midday light makes the tones soft. The paint layer is thin, allowing the ground to shine through.

7086.d: Esiplaanil osa pargist kõrgete raagus puude ja üksikute inimfiguuridega. Taga lumiste katustega majad.
7086.de: In the foreground part of a park with tall bare trees and a few human figures. Behind, houses with snowy roofs.

7088.d: Avar kupliline maastik üksikute lumelaikudega pruunikatel põldudel. Küngaste vahel puudegrupid majadega, veesilmad. Kaugemal metsaga kaetud nõlvad. Ekspressiivne maalilaad.
7088.de: Wide domed landscape with single patches of snow on brownish fields. Between the hills groups of trees with houses, small bodies of water. Further away slopes covered with forest. Expressive painting style.

7090.d: Värvilistest stiliseeritud kujunditest kombineeritud dekoratiivne lõvipea kujutis, kelle nina ja näoosa moodustab seisev naisfiguur. Valdavalt punased, pruunid, kollased toonid, must kontuurjoon lainjaid pindu eraldamas.
7090.de: A decorative image of a lion's head composed of coloured stylised forms, whose nose and facial area are formed by a standing female figure. Predominantly red, brown, yellow tones, with a black contour line separating the wavy surfaces.

7091.d: Kolme tööriietuses mehe rinnapilt - kaks otsevaates, keskmine profiilis paremale. Näovärv tume, riietus väviline, foonil geomeetrilised kujundid.
7091.de: Bust portraits of three men in work clothes - two in frontal view, the middle one in profile to the right. Dark facial colouring, colourful clothing, geometric shapes in the background.

7092.d: Kahe mehe rinnafiguurid - vasakpoolne heledapäine ja sinises särgis, parempoolne tumedajuukseline pruunis pintsakus.
7092.de: Chest figures of two men - the one on the left fair-haired and in a blue shirt, the one on the right dark-haired in a brown jacket.

7120.d: Abstraktsetest kujunditest värvikas kompositsioon. Roosad-rohekad pinnad, üksikud pruunid pintslitõmbed heledate pindade vahel. Kohati väga pastoosne.
7120.de: A colourful composition of abstract shapes. Pink-greenish surfaces, occasional brown brushstrokes between light surfaces. In places very pastose.

7131.d: Vaade Emajõele ja selle vasakule kaldale. Kõrgete pruunikas-lillakate puude all hooneid ja paadisild kirevate paatidega.
7131.de: View of the Emajõgi river and its left bank. Buildings under tall brownish-purple trees and a boat landing with colourful boats.

7133.d: Hallipäise, heledas särgis vanema mehe poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule. Foon pruunikates-rohekates-punakates toonides.
7133.de: Half-figure of an elderly, grey-haired man in a light shirt, half-turned to the left. Background in brownish-greenish-reddish tones.

7134.d: Tumeda, rohekaspruuni draperii taustal helepruun kann ja madal hall vaas lilledega, kaks kaussi puuviljadega ja neli pudelit.
7134.de: Against a dark, greenish-brown drapery background a light brown jug and a low grey vase with flowers, two bowls with fruit and four bottles.

7135.d: Esiplaanil lage lumine väljak üksikute puudega. Eemal majad, nende taga kõrged puud.
7135.de: In the foreground a bare snowy square with solitary trees. In the distance houses, behind them tall trees.

7139.d: Pildi keskel suur, roosa seosega lillekorv, mitmesuguste aialilledega. Vasakul esiplaanil väiksem korv lilledega. Paremal nurgas suur roheline leht maasikatega.
7139.de: In the middle of the picture, a large pink woven flower basket with various garden flowers. In the foreground on the left, a smaller basket with flowers. In the right corner, a large green leaf with strawberries.

7140.d: Keskel kolm lehtpuud. Vasakule ja paremale jäävad majad. Foonil mets.
7140.de: Three deciduous trees in the centre. Houses on the left and right. Forest in the background.

7141.d: Mitmevärviliste abstraktsete kujundite ja pindade kompositsioon.
7141.de: Composition of multicoloured abstract shapes and planes.

7142.d: Mitmevärvilised, põhiliselt rohelistes toonides, abstraktsed kujundid ja pinnad.
7142.de: Multicoloured, mainly in green tones, abstract shapes and surfaces.

7143.d: Punakas toonis, peene kontuuriga väikesteks värvilisteks pindadeks jaotatud kompositsioon. All kaarjas avause kujutis.
7143.de: Composition in reddish tones, divided by fine contours into small coloured areas. Below, depiction of an arched opening.

7165.d: Istuva naise 3/4 figuur en face rohelise-mustatriibulise riide taustal. Peakatteta, seljas sinakas-must mantel, roosa kleit, mustad kindad.
7165.de: 3/4 figure of a seated woman en face against a green-and-black striped fabric background. Without a headdress, wearing a bluish-black coat, a pink dress, black gloves.

7166.d: Tütarlapse rinnaportree otsevaates, pea ülaosa servaga lõigatud. Juuksed tumedad, kleit punane. Foon mustriline.
7166.de: Bust portrait of a girl in frontal view, the top of the head cut off by the edge. Hair dark, dress red. Background patterned.

7271.d: Sügisene pargivaade. Esiplaanil keskel tee, mis kaardub paremale ja kaob puutüvede taha. Teest vasakul ja paremal sirgete tüvedega, kauguses hajuvad, maali ülaservani ulatuvad puud. Kaugemal teel punases riides naisfiguur ja meesfiguur.
7271.de: Autumn park view. In the foreground in the centre a path curving to the right and disappearing behind tree trunks. To the left and right of the path, straight-trunked trees reaching to the top edge of the painting, thinning out in the distance. Further along the path a female figure in red clothing and a male figure.

7272.d: Esiplaanil keskealise mehe rinnaportree poolpöördes vasakule. Taga vasakul meri ja paadid, paremal kaldaäär.
7272.de: In the foreground a bust portrait of a middle-aged man in half-turn to the left. Behind on the left the sea and boats, on the right the shoreline.

7273.d: Esiplaanil paadisadamas võrkudest kalakorjamine: seljaga kaks meest ja üks naine, vastaspoolel samuti kaks meest ja naine. Taga vasakul sinetav meri, kajakad ja valge torn roosa katusega, paremal ehitus.
7273.de: In the foreground, at a boat harbour, collecting fish from nets: two men and one woman with their backs turned, on the opposite side likewise two men and a woman. In the background on the left the bluish sea, seagulls and a white tower with a pink roof, on the right a building.

7288.d: Väike-Munamägi ja Tedremägi. Kaks kõrvutiasetsevat tumerohelise metsaga kaetud madalat mäekuplit. Mägede jalamil kollakas-pruunikas sügismaastik, mis esiplaanil muutub erinevate varjunditega roheliseks. Paremal heleroheline põld. Horisondil tume mets. Kollakas kiudpilvedega kaetud taevas silmapiiri kohal lillaka varjundiga.
7288.de: Väike-Munamägi and Tedremägi. Two adjacent low hill domes covered with dark green forest. At the foot of the hills a yellowish-brownish autumn landscape, which in the foreground turns green with various shades. On the right a light green field. Dark forest on the horizon. A yellowish sky covered with cirrus clouds, with a purplish tinge above the horizon.

7289.d: Künklik maastik, esiplaanil keskel järv. Taevas hall, silmapiiril sinetavad metsad.
7289.de: Hilly landscape, a lake in the middle of the foreground. Grey sky, bluish forests on the horizon.

7290.d: Esiplaanil rohelised põllud ja väike järv. Taamal sinised mäed.
7290.de: In the foreground green fields and a small lake. Blue mountains in the distance.

7291.d: Lõuna-Eesti künklik panoraam: ees heledad põllud, mis vahelduvad tumedate viirgudega, taga metsased nõlvakud.
7291.de: A hilly panorama of South Estonia: in front, light fields alternating with dark strips, behind forested slopes.

7293.d: Panoraamvaade Lõuna-Eesti maastikule. Eespool roosakad-rohekad põllusiilud vaheldumisi rõheliste metsadega. Keskel helesinine veekogu. Silmapiiril, taeva ja maa vahel sinine viirg.
7293.de: Panoramic view of a South Estonian landscape. In the foreground pinkish-greenish field strips alternating with green forests. In the middle a light blue body of water. On the horizon, between sky and land, a blue streak.

7298.d: Ookertoonides Lõuna-Eesti maastik. Taamal tumedad metsad, eespool punakad, ookerjad põllusiilud. Kuppelmaastikus looklevad roosakad teed. Eespool all sinine veekogu, mille servas valget jääkirmet.
7298.de: South Estonian landscape in ochre tones. Dark forests in the distance, reddish, ochre-coloured field strips in the foreground. Pinkish roads winding through the rolling landscape. Below in the foreground a blue body of water, with white ice glaze at its edge.

7303.d: Murul istuva tumedajuukselise tütarlapse täisfiguur otsevaates. Seljas valge seelik ja punane pluus. Vasak käsi toetub maha, parem parema jala säärele. Heleroheline foon kollaste ja valgete laikudega.
7303.de: Full figure of a dark-haired girl sitting on grass, seen frontally. Wearing a white skirt and red blouse. Left hand resting on the ground, right hand on her right shin. Light green background with yellow and white patches.

7353.d: Esiplaanil jõe ääres kummuli keeratud paat ja palgid. Üle jõe näha linna panoraamne vaade.
7353.de: In the foreground by the river a capsized boat and logs. Across the river a panoramic view of the town can be seen.

7402.d: Kolmveerand pildipinnast rohelistes toonides rannaäär, mida lõikavad sinised veeõõned, tagapool mereriba, taevas rohekas.
7402.de: Three-quarters of the picture surface is a shoreline in green tones, cut by blue pools of water, behind it a strip of sea, the sky greenish.

7491.d: Majadegrupp, millede vahel puitmaterjali kuhjad. Vasakpoolse kuuri otsauksest paistab saekaater. Esiplaanil töötavaid mehefiguure. Maalitud hallikas üldtoonis, siin-seal lund valgete laikudena.
7491.de: A group of houses, among which piles of timber. Through the end door of the shed on the left a sawmill is visible. In the foreground figures of working men. Painted in a greyish overall tone, here and there snow in white patches.

7495.d: Esiplaanil rohelised põõsad ja roheline kallas. Keskel väike helesinine veekogu. Selle taga vasakul sügisvärvides tõusev kallas, mitmevärviliste katustega majade rida. Paremal rohelise- ja kollasekirjud puud ja sinetavad metsad. Taevas hallikas-sinine, kohati roosa varjundiga.
7495.de: In the foreground, green bushes and a green bank. In the middle, a small light blue body of water. Behind it on the left, a rising bank in autumn colours, a row of houses with multicoloured roofs. On the right, trees mottled with green and yellow, and bluish forests. The sky is greyish-blue, with a pinkish tinge in places.

7504.d: Suurejooneline panoraamne ehitusmaastik õhetava taeva ja mustade suitsupilvedega. Esiplaanil kraanade ja tellingute rõhutamise abil saavutatud horisontaalsete ja vertikaalsete rütmide tasakaal. Esiplaanil all tumepunase seinaga pikk pooleliolev ehitus. Roosas, tumepunases ja mustas värvigammas. Kohati pastoosselt ja spaatliga maalitud.
7504.de: A grand panoramic construction landscape with a glowing sky and black smoke clouds. In the foreground a balance of horizontal and vertical rhythms achieved through the emphasis of cranes and scaffolding. In the foreground below a long unfinished building with a dark red wall. In a colour range of pink, dark red and black. In places painted in impasto and with a palette knife.

7510.d: Ülaltvaade Vabaduse platsil toimuvale demonstratsioonile. Keskel inimeste kolonnid lippude ja loosungitega liikumas üle väljaku. Paremal väljaku ääres raagus puud, tagapool kõrged hooned üle puude paistmas. Vaba käsitluslaad, sinkjas-hall koloriit.
7510.de: Bird's-eye view of a demonstration taking place on Vabaduse Square. In the centre, columns of people with flags and slogans moving across the square. On the right, at the edge of the square, bare trees, behind which tall buildings appear above the trees. Free handling, bluish-grey colouring.

7516.d: Hallil, pintsliga tihedalt läbitöötatud foonil all paremas nurgas geomeetrilistest kujunditest kompositsioon, mis koosneb mustast jämedast vertikaalsest joonest, hallist punase piirjoonega munast, segmendist ja kollakast aluspinnast.
7516.de: On a grey background densely worked with a brush, in the lower right corner a composition of geometric shapes, consisting of a thick black vertical line, a grey egg with a red outline, a segment, and a yellowish base surface.

7517.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon enamasti selgepiirilistest, valdavalt musta-halli-valge-kollase kombinatsioonis pindadest. Keskel mustale liitub paremalt kaarja piirjoonega valge, sidrunkollased, rohelised laigud. Hoogsalt maalitud, pintslilöögid nähtavad.
7517.de: Abstract composition consisting mostly of sharply defined planes in a combination of black-grey-white-yellow. In the centre, joined to the black from the right, white, lemon-yellow and green patches with a curved outline. Painted vigorously, brushstrokes visible.

7518.d: Kitsa triibu pilvevines taeva all keskpäevavalguses sädelev meri. Veeosa akvarellilikult läbipaistev, lainesäbru markeerivate värviliste täpikestega. Esiplaanil, allosas tükike erkoranži adrust randa.
7518.de: Sea sparkling in midday light under a sky with a narrow strip of clouds. The water area is watercolour-like transparent, marked with colourful dots indicating the ripple of waves. In the foreground, at the bottom, a piece of bright orange seaweed on the shore.

7541.d: Vaade puudega kaetud mäekuplile, puuvõrad peente heledate joontena tumedasse pinda kraabitud. Mäe jalamil vasakul heledalt valgustatud ala ja kaks madalat hoonet. Eespool hele mäekülg, sinine taevas. Üldistav kujutamisviis.
7541.de: View of a tree-covered hilltop, the tree crowns scratched as fine light lines into the dark surface. At the foot of the hill on the left a brightly lit area and two low buildings. In front a light hillside, blue sky. A generalising manner of depiction.

7570.dm: kõrgus: 32.7 cm (lm); kujutise laius: 20.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 27.5 cm; laius: 24.0 cm (lm)
7570.d: Lõunamaine maastikumotiiv: esiplaanil kaks lõikuvat kitsast teed, ristumiskohal jalgratta toetamiseks mõeldud post. Vasakul kaks raagus okstega puud. Keskplaanis kaks valget, madalat, punaste katustega maja. Ülaosas rohelusega kaetud mäed ja kollane taevas.
7570.de: A southern landscape motif: in the foreground two narrow intersecting roads, at the crossing point a post meant for propping up a bicycle. On the left two trees with bare branches. In the middle ground two low white houses with red roofs. In the upper part mountains covered with greenery and a yellow sky.

7606.d: Kirevais, lillakas-oranžides toonides täppivas laadis maalitud rannaäärne. Esiplaanil purjekad vees, kaldal mitmekorruselised majad. Taamal, keskel kirikutorn.
7606.de: A seaside scene painted in a colourful, lilac-orange pointillist manner. In the foreground sailboats on the water, on the shore multi-storey houses. Further away, in the centre, a church tower.

7673.d: Õhuliste kardinate taustal istumas kaks heledas, napi ülaosaga volangidega kleidis noort naist. Vasakpoolne otsevaates, pea tõstetud, silmad suletud. Parempoolne külgvaates, pisut ette kallutatud ülakehaga, mõttesse vajunud ilmega tütarlaps. Helesinakad õrnad toonid, õhuline visandlik laad.
7673.de: Against a background of airy curtains, two young women sit in light-coloured dresses with sparse, flounced upper parts. The one on the left is frontal, head raised, eyes closed. The one on the right is in profile, upper body leaning slightly forward, a girl with a pensive expression. Delicate light-blue tones, an airy, sketch-like style.

7676.d: Keskealise mehe poolfiguur otsevaates, käed (osaliselt servaga lõigatud) hoiavad raamatut, seljas sinine kuun ja lillakas särk.
7676.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man in frontal view, hands (partly cut off by the edge) holding a book, wearing a blue kuub coat and a purplish shirt.

7677.d: Paadis neli mõrda tõmbavat kalurit, kelledest üks selgvaates.
7677.de: Four fishermen pulling a fyke net in a boat, one of them seen frontally.

7678.d: Lehtmets kahe valgetes õites puuga. Esiplaanil kullerkupud. Lillakas taevas suur kollane täiskuu.
7678.de: Deciduous forest with two trees in white blossom. In the foreground marsh marigolds. Purplish sky with a large yellow full moon.

7687.d: Värvikalt, roosades-rohelistes-helesinistes toonides täppivalt maalitud vaade sadamale mere poolt. Ranna ääres rida purjekaid, väiksemaid paate. Kaldal vasakul suurte puude taustal heledad majad. Maalitud pastoosselt.
7687.de: Colourfully, in pink-green-light blue tones, painted in dots, a view of a harbour from the sea. Along the shore a row of sailboats, smaller boats. On the shore on the left light-coloured houses against a background of large trees. Painted pastosely.

7689.d: Täppivas laadis maalitud meremotiiv. Heledate pilvede all türkiissinine kolmnurk merest, paremal oranžikate, beežide kõrkjatega rand.

7690.d: Valkjassinistes toonides maalitud vaade lumiste okstega metsaalusele. Keskosas väike lagendik siniste varjudega. Maalitud pastoosselt lühikeste pintslilöökidega.
7690.de: Painted in whitish-blue tones, a view of a forest floor with snowy branches. In the middle, a small clearing with blue shadows. Painted pastosely with short brushstrokes.

7691.d: Säravates - oranžid, punased, rohelised, sinised, valkjad - värvides maastikupilt. Paremas servas kaks puud. Silmapiirijoonel õrnroosakas viirg.
7691.de: A landscape in radiant - orange, red, green, blue, whitish - colours. Two trees at the right edge. A pale pink streak on the horizon line.

7692.d: Erksinise, roosade pilvedega taeva all rannamotiiv. Keskosas, luidete vahel kolm kõrgemat puud. Esiplaanil ja vasakul vesi. Maalitud kirevalt, täppivas laadis.
7692.de: Beach motif under a bright blue sky with pink clouds. In the middle part, among the dunes, three taller trees. In the foreground and on the left, water. Painted colourfully, in a dotted manner.

7710.d: Vaade Pikale tänavale. Kollaka ja pruunikas-oranži viilkatusega maja fassaadid. Nende ees tänaval inimesi ja kass.
7710.de: View of Pikk Street. Facades of houses with yellowish and brownish-orange gable roofs. In front of them, on the street, people and a cat.

7721.d: Lillelise vaiba ja roosa seina foonil istuva, hallis riietuses vana mehe kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates.
7721.de: Three-quarter figure of an old man dressed in grey, seen frontally, against a background of a floral carpet and a pink wall.

7757.d: Esiplaanil kolm kraanat, mõned laevad ja paadid. Nende taga heledates toonides virvendav vesi laevadega. Silmapiiril sinetavad mäed. Taevas sinine valgete pilvedega.
7757.de: In the foreground three cranes, some ships and boats. Behind them shimmering water in light tones with ships. On the horizon bluish mountains. The sky blue with white clouds.

7759.d: Esiplaanil lõkke kohale riputatud teekann. Paremal vanamees kõrvikmütsis, vasakul kaks naist, kelledest parempoolsel süles laps. Kujutatavad kuuluvad mongoloidsesse rassi. Foon tume.
7759.de: In the foreground a teakettle hung above a campfire. On the right an old man in a fur cap, on the left two women, one of whom has a child in her lap. The figures belong to the Mongoloid race. Background dark.

7760.d: Prillidega mehe istuv põlvportree, parem käsi toetub põlvele, vasak on lõua juurde viidud, ilme mõtlik. Fooniks teatriafišš.
7760.de: Sitting knee-length portrait of a bespectacled man, right hand resting on the knee, left brought up to the chin, pensive expression. Background a theatre poster.

7761.d: Keskealise tüseda mehe poolfiguur otsevaates. Parem käsi toetub vaadile, vasak hoiab põlletraksidest. Foon heleroheline.
7761.de: Half-figure of a stout middle-aged man in frontal view. Right hand resting on the easel, left hand holding his apron straps. Light green background.

7762.d: Sinise draperii taustal lillakas-valge krüsanteem pruunis potis.
7762.de: Against a blue drapery background a purplish-white chrysanthemum in a brown pot.

7763.d: Voodil istuva roosakas triibulises pidžaamas poisikese täisfiguur. Foon rohekas.
7763.de: Full figure of a boy sitting on a bed, in pinkish striped pyjamas. Greenish background.

7766.d: Suvine vaade merele. Alumine pool maalipinnast kujutab rohtu kasvanud, liivalaikudega randa. Vee piiril kive, kõrkjaid. Kitsal rohekal mereosal valged lainevahu triibud. Õrn kollakassinine taevas silmapiiri kohal kaetud pilvedega. Maalitud hoogsalt, suure üldistusega.
7766.de: Summer view of the sea. The lower half of the painting depicts a grassy shore with patches of sand. Stones and rushes at the water's edge. On the narrow greenish sea area, white streaks of wave foam. A delicate yellowish-blue sky above the horizon covered with clouds. Painted vigorously, with great generalisation.

7767.d: Tihedalt hallide ja pruunide pintslilöökidega läbitöötatud abstraktne kompositsioon, millest kirkaina eralduvad üksikud kollased ja punased laigud.
7767.de: A densely worked abstract composition of grey and brown brushstrokes, from which individual yellow and red patches vividly stand out.

7768.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon, mille foon on diagonaalis jaotatud kaheks: vasakult foon valge, paremalt hall. Üle töö pinna värvilised erikujulised pintslilöögid, kohati väga pastoossed.
7768.de: Abstract composition, the background of which is divided diagonally in two: from the left the background is white, from the right grey. Over the surface of the work coloured brushstrokes of various shapes, in places very impasto.

7769.d: Kollastest, rohelistest, pruunidest ja sinistest suurtest värvipindadest koosnev peaaegu abstraktselt mõjuv kompositsioon, millesse tumedate joontega on vaevu aimatavalt joonistatud profiilis pea ja ülakeha.
7769.de: An almost abstract-seeming composition consisting of large colour areas of yellow, green, brown and blue, into which a head and upper body in profile are barely discernibly drawn with dark lines.

7770.d: Abstraktne, lõpuni viimistlemata kompositsioon: heledal foonil punased, hallid ja ookritoonides jooned ja geomeetrilisteks kujunditeks vormitud pinnad.
7770.de: Abstract, unfinished composition: on a light background red, grey and ochre-toned lines and surfaces shaped into geometric forms.

7771.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 66.0 cm; kujutise laius: 48.0 cm; laius: 50.0 cm; kõrgus: 69.7 cm
7771.d: Laiadest hoogsatest pintslilöökidest moodustuv abstraktne kompositsioon, peamiselt punastes, sinistes ja pruunides toonides. Vasak alumine nurk mõjub heledalt ja kergelt, kompositsioon muutub diagonaalselt parema ülanurga suunas üha raskemaks ja pastoossemaks.
7771.de: An abstract composition formed of broad sweeping brushstrokes, mainly in red, blue and brown tones. The lower left corner appears light and airy, the composition grows increasingly heavy and pastose diagonally towards the upper right corner.

7772.d: Värvilistest geomeetrilistest kujunditest koostatud abstraktne kompositsioon. Peamiselt kasutatud ringi, poolringi ja kolmnurka, mida piiravad pruunid või rohelised jooned. Rohelised, hallid, punased toonid.
7772.de: Abstract composition composed of coloured geometric shapes. Mainly circles, semicircles and triangles are used, bordered by brown or green lines. Green, grey, red tones.

7773.d: Vaade mereäärsele paadisadamale, paadikuuride, tünnide, meremärkide, paatidega vee piiril. Inimesed kõikjal tegevuses. Esiplaanil paremal kolm meest vestluses, neist parempoolne selgvaates roosakas pluusis mees toetumas jalgrattale. Üldistav laad, kontrastsed värvid.
7773.de: View of a seaside boat harbour, with boat sheds, barrels, sea marks, boats at the water's edge. People everywhere, occupied with various activities. In the foreground on the right, three men in conversation, of whom the one on the right, shown in full front view in a pinkish blouse, is leaning on a bicycle. Generalising style, contrasting colours.

7789.d: Raamaturiiuli kirjul foonil mehe istuv täisfiguur. Kerge peapööre vasakule, pealagi paljas, ees prillid; põlvedele toetuvad käed suitseva sigaretiga ees. Ülikond ühtlaselt hall. Maalitud õhukeselt suures pinnas, figuur piiratud musta kontuurjoonega.
7789.de: Full figure of a seated man against a motley background of a bookshelf. Slight turn of the head to the left, bald crown, glasses in front; hands resting on the knees with a smoking cigarette held in front. Suit uniformly grey. Painted thinly over a large surface, the figure bounded by a black contour line.

7790.d: Esiplaanil hulk raudteerööpaid ja vaguneid. Eemal maju ja Toompea siluett.
7790.de: In the foreground a number of railway tracks and wagons. In the distance houses and the silhouette of Toompea.

7857.d: Vasakul lippude taustal viiulit mängiv mees, paremal kuulavad sõdurid püssidega. Maalitud punastes toonides.
7857.de: On the left a man playing the violin against a background of flags, on the right soldiers with rifles listening. Painted in red tones.

7858.d: Tumedates mustades ja punastes toonides pildipinda läbivad heledad teravad kolmnurksed kujundid. Allosas heledas kolmnurgas seisab prillides mehe poolfiguur, käed kõrval.
7858.de: Light, sharp triangular shapes cross the picture surface in dark black and red tones. In the lower part, in a light triangle, stands the half-figure of a man wearing glasses, arms at his sides.

7859.d: Valges kitlis keskealise mehe poolfiguur punasel foonil. Otsevaates, vasaku käe nimetissõrm vasakul põsel.
7859.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man in a white smock against a red background. Frontal view, the index finger of the left hand on the left cheek.

7860.d: Kaksikportree sinakais-rohekais toonides. Kaks keskealise mehe rinnafiguuri otsevaates.
7860.de: A double portrait in bluish-greenish tones. Two chest-length figures of a middle-aged man in frontal view.

7933.d: Ümarakujulises heledas vaasis bukett sireleid. Maalitud hõredate pintslilüketega, lastes kõlada heledal aluspinnal.
7933.de: A bouquet of lilacs in a round light-coloured vase. Painted with sparse brushstrokes, letting the light ground show through.

7944.d: Esiplaanil pisut diagonaalse suunaga jõgi. Maali vasakul äärel, esiplaanil jõe kaldal raagus puud. Maali vasakul poolel üle jõe viiv sild. Paremal poolel jõel mõned laevad, nende taga hall hoone. Kaugemal udus metsad. Taevas hall.
7944.de: In the foreground, a slightly diagonally directed river. On the left edge of the painting, in the foreground on the riverbank, bare trees. On the left half of the painting, a bridge crossing the river. On the right half, on the river some ships, behind them a grey building. Further away, forests in mist. The sky grey.

7945.d: Neli punast korstent, nende kohal suitsupilv. Esiplaanil vasakul neli väikest inimfiguuri.
7945.de: Four red chimneys, above them a cloud of smoke. In the foreground on the left four small human figures.

7946.d: Vasakul, metallkonstruktsioonide vahel kolm keevitusmaskides meest töötamas. Esiplaanil paremal töölise poolfiguur, mask tõstetud, punaka poolkaarekujulise vormi ees. Nurgelises, üldistavas laadis kompositsioon.
7946.de: On the left, between metal structures, three men in welding masks at work. In the foreground on the right, the half-figure of a worker, mask raised, in front of a reddish semicircular form. Composition in an angular, generalized manner.

7958.d: Tumesinised mäed helesinise taeva taustal. Esiplaanil riba lillakates ja pruunikates toonides künklikku maastikku.
7958.de: Dark blue mountains against a light blue sky background. In the foreground a strip of hilly landscape in purplish and brownish tones.

7959.d: Vasakul ja keskel taraga piiratud majadegruppe ja puid. Esiplaanil lumel pikad sinised puude varjud.
7959.de: On the left and in the centre groups of houses enclosed by fences and trees. In the foreground on the snow, long blue shadows of trees.

7960.d: Paremal tumedad raagus puud, vasemale jäävad allavaates sinakates toonides Katused, taga paremal tõuseb linnamüüri torn. Taevas hele.
7960.de: On the right dark bare trees, to the left in a bird's-eye view roofs in bluish tones, behind on the right a city wall tower rises. Sky bright.

7961.d: Laual samovar ja punutud korv lõngakeradega. Paremal osa sisselõigatud ornamendiga tooli seljatoest.
7961.de: On the table a samovar and a woven basket with balls of yarn. On the right part of the backrest of a chair with cut-out ornament.

7962.d: Neli inimest ühte, lamavat inimest kandmas.
7962.de: Four people carrying one, a lying person.

7963.d: Sinise-valgekirjul alsusel vasakul roheline, punaste refleksidega samovar. Paremal pruun kann ja õunad.
7963.de: On a blue-and-white patterned tablecloth on the left, a green samovar with red reflections. On the right a brown jug and apples.

7964.d: Kollase taeva ja siniste kauguste foonil kolm meest ja üks naine tumeda masina peal.
7964.de: Against the background of a yellow sky and blue distances, three men and one woman on a dark machine.

7965.d: Kõrged sinised, osaliselt lumega kaetud mäed peegelduvad esiplaanil olevas veekogus.
7965.de: Tall blue, partly snow-covered mountains reflected in the body of water in the foreground.

7966.d: Tumeda, roheka taeva foonil kõrged tehasehooned. Ühest korstnast tuleb kollast suitsu.
7966.de: Tall factory buildings against a dark, greenish sky background. Yellow smoke coming from one chimney.

8031.d: Esiplaanil keskel kaugusse viiv tee, sellest paremal ja vasakul varemed, viltused postid, lennukirusud. Taevas lillakas-hall, paremal punane.
8031.de: In the foreground, in the centre, a road leading into the distance, to the right and left of it ruins, tilted posts, aircraft wreckage. Sky purplish-grey, red on the right.

8033.d: Ehitusplats kujutatud rõhutatud joonte ja pindadega, kollakas-ooker ja pruunid toonid. Taga punane lipp.
8033.de: A construction site depicted with emphasised lines and planes, yellowish-ochre and brown tones. A red flag in the background.

8034.d: Üle maalipinna laiub mäekülg, mille allosas (vastu allserva) majade rida, kust kerkivad üles lehvivad kangad. Maalitud pruunikates ja sinakates toonides helepunaste aktsentidega.
8034.de: A mountainside spreads across the painting's surface, at its lower part (against the lower edge) a row of houses, from which fluttering cloths rise up. Painted in brownish and bluish tones with light red accents.

8035.d: Vana naise figuur otsevaates, kelle kortsunud näos tühjad silmakoopad. Seljas violetne kimano. Fooniks Jaapani linnapilt.
8035.de: Frontal figure of an old woman, her wrinkled face showing empty eye sockets. Wearing a violet kimono. Background a Japanese cityscape.

8036.d: Üle pildi pinna vaade linnale, mis on maalil üles ehitatud joonterütmile; koloriidis domineerib tume, vaheldatud siniste ja punaste toonidega, kauguses kerkivad heledad majablokid.
8036.de: A view over the picture surface to a city, which in the painting is built up on a rhythm of lines; the colouring is dominated by dark tones, alternating with blue and red shades, in the distance light blocks of houses rise.

8037.d: Jaapani tütarlapse põlvportree otsevaates, kirjus kimanos, sõrmed ees seoses.
8037.de: Knee-length portrait of a Japanese girl in a frontal view, in a patterned kimono, fingers clasped in front.

8038.d: Veekogul seisavad paljud paadid, millede mastid tõusevad paralleelselt ülaservani. Taha vasemale jäävad punasekatuselised majad.
8038.de: Many boats are standing on the water, their masts rising parallel to the upper edge. Behind them to the left are houses with red roofs.

8039.d: Pildi alumises osas kolm jaapanlanna pead, tihedalt üksteise kõrvale paigutatud, kõrgetes, ehitud soengutes. Fooniks heledates toonides templikujutis.
8039.de: In the lower part of the picture three heads of Japanese women, placed closely next to one another, in tall, adorned hairstyles. Background a temple depiction in light tones.

8040.d: Peaaegu kogu pildi ulatuses Colosseumi interjööri kujutis, maalitud tumedate pruunikate ja valkjate toonidega, rõhutades ümarakujulist keskosa ringjoonega. Ülaossa jääb kitsas sinine taevariba.
8040.de: Almost the entire extent of the picture shows the interior of the Colosseum, painted in dark brownish and whitish tones, emphasising the round central part with a circular line. A narrow blue strip of sky remains at the top.

8041.d: Öine vaade üle Seine'i Notre-Dame'i valgustatud fassaadile.
8041.de: A night view over the Seine to the illuminated façade of Notre-Dame.

8042.d: Kirevas riietuses jaapanlanna kolmveeranfiguur selgvaates, nägu profiilis vasakule. Taga paremal osa teisest figuurist.
8042.de: Three-quarter figure of a Japanese woman in colourful clothing, seen frontally, her face in profile facing left. Behind on the right part of another figure.

8043.d: Kirjul foonil tumedanahalise, idamaises rõivastuses naise seisev kolmveerandfiguur, keha otsevaates, nägu profiilis.
8043.de: Against a colourful background, a standing three-quarter figure of a dark-skinned woman in oriental dress, the body in frontal view, the face in profile.

8044.d: Esiplaanil vasakul valkjates toonides Constantinuse triumfikaar. Paremal pruunikasrohelised arkaadidega varemed.
8044.de: In the foreground on the left, the Arch of Constantine in whitish tones. On the right, brownish-green ruins with arcades.

8045.d: Tumesinisel taustal heledad vertikaal- ja horisontaaljooned ning nelinurgad.
8045.de: On a dark blue background, light vertical and horizontal lines and quadrangles.

8046.d: Pildi keskel käetugedega toolis istuva tumedajuukselise, pika kitsa nina, väikese suu ja kitsaste silmadega, tütarlapse kolmveerandfiguur. Seljas punane pikkade käistega kleit. Mõlemad käed hoidmas kinni tooli käetugedest.
8046.de: In the middle of the picture a three-quarter figure of a dark-haired girl with a long narrow nose, small mouth and narrow eyes, sitting in a chair with armrests. Wearing a red long-sleeved dress. Both hands holding onto the armrests of the chair.

8051.d: Kogu pildi pinna võtab enda alla kahe kupliga kirikuhoone; kaunistatud rohkete skulptuuridega. Esiplaanil, sissekäigu juures miniatuursed inimfiguurid. Koloriit tume, ülekaalus sinised toonid.
8051.de: The whole surface of the picture is occupied by a two-domed church building, decorated with numerous sculptures. In the foreground, by the entrance, miniature human figures. Dark colour scheme, blue tones predominant.

8053.d: Punasel taustal tõmmunahalise, tugevate näojoontega jaapani mehe portree. Pea kerges pöördes vasakule, pilk suunatud üles. Ümber pea seotud kitsa ribana valge rätt.
8053.de: Against a red background, portrait of a swarthy Japanese man with strong facial features. The head in a slight turn to the left, gaze directed upward. A narrow strip of white cloth tied around the head.

8055.d: Peaaegu täisprofiilis sinistes toonides tütarlapse pea, näo vasak pool jääb varju, juuksed kuklalt üles kammitud. Profiil jätab punasele foonile tugeva sinise varju. Etüüdilikult maalitud.
8055.de: Almost full-profile head of a girl in blue tones, the left side of the face left in shadow, hair combed up from the nape. The profile casts a strong blue shadow on the red background. Painted in an etude-like manner.

8070.dm: kõrgus: 42.3 cm; sügavus: 15.0 cm; laius: 60.0 cm
8070.d: Musta pappaluse keskele kinnitatud vineerist kast, mis omakorda vaheseinaga pikuti pooleks jagatud. Kasti siseseinad peegelduvast metallist, põhja maalitud erksavärvilised portreesiluetid. Mõlemal kastipoolel sarnane, erinevas värvikombinatsiooniskujutis: paremal kaabuga mehe selg-, vasakul otsevaade sinise, kollase, rohelise ja punasega pinnaliselt maalituna. Kastipõhjal, figuuride all roosa vööt, millele kinnitub pruun lehekestega metallist puuoks. Mustal alusel kahel pool külgedel valgusfoori kujund kolme üksteise all paikneva rohelisest klaasist märgiga-tulega.
8070.de: A plywood box fastened to the centre of a black cardboard base, itself divided lengthwise into two by a partition. The inner walls of the box are of reflective metal, with brightly coloured portrait silhouettes painted on the bottom. Both halves of the box show a similar depiction in different colour combinations: on the right the back view of a man in a hat, on the left a frontal view painted flatly in blue, yellow, green and red. On the bottom of the box, beneath the figures, a pink strip, to which a brown, leafed metal tree branch is attached. On the black base, on both sides, a traffic light figure with three green glass signal lights placed one below the other.

8090.dm: kõrgus: 91.0 cm; sügavus: 33.0 cm; laius: 58.5 cm

8092.d: Erkkollasel alusriidel punase, sinise, valge ja mustaga kombineeritud tekstiilidest kujundid, millel kaks halli tooni lindu tikitud alusmaterjalile.

8096.de: View into a small washroom with blue walls, with a wash table and a mirror in which

8097.de: A mirror reflection of a hairdresser's workroom with red walls: in the centre a fair-haired female hairdresser cutting a young man's hair, interior behind. In the foreground, in front of the mirror, a dark tabletop with a wash-basin, small bottles and implements. Crumpled brushwork, in places pastose, in places sketchy.

8104.de: An interior with a glowing red hearth, a large roller above it, two men busy at the hearth. Behind, in the room, a tiny window opening. Brightly coloured, turquoise and orange dominate. A vigorous, marking manner of depiction.

8107.d: Liikumishoos must ratsahobune  külgvaates takistust ületamas, valgete pükste, punase kuuega
8107.de: A black riding horse in motion, seen from the side, jumping over an obstacle, with white trousers and a red coat

8110.d: Keskealise mehe poolfiguur poolkülgvaates vasakule, parema käega hoiab laual pika kaelaga
8110.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man in half-profile facing left, holding a long-necked

8118.de: Of clearly outlined flat surfaces in yellow, rust, black-grey tones

8123.d: Kolmele värvile (roosa, koobaltsinine, roheline) rajatud popilik kompositsioon. Roosa siluett naisaktist rohelisel, sinisel pinnalisel
8123.de: A pop-like composition built on three colours (pink, cobalt blue, green). A pink silhouette of a female nude on a green, blue flat surface

8124.d: Kolmele värvile (helesinine, heleroheline, vanaroosa) rajatud dekoratiivne kompositsioon roosakast siluett-kujundist selgepiirilisel sini-rohelisel foonil.
8124.de: A decorative composition built on three colours (light blue, light green, old rose) of a pinkish silhouette shape against a clearly delineated blue-green background.

8125.de: A light pink silhouette depicting a male nude on a light blue, below on a moss-green surfaced

8163.d: Valgete katustega ja üksikute valgustatud akendega majad. Paremal televisioonimast, taamal ähmased majade siluetid.
8163.de: Houses with white roofs and a few lit windows. On the right a television mast, in the background blurred silhouettes of houses.

8164.d: Maastik kõrgete hallide tehasehoonetega heleda taeva taustal.
8164.de: A landscape with tall grey factory buildings against a light sky.

8166.d: Toomkiriku esine väljak pärnadega, millede kroonid pildi ülaservaga läbi lõigatud, puudest tumedad varjud roosatoonilisel väljakul. Toomkirikust näha vaid nurgake. Taga Kreutzwaldi nim. Raamatukogu heleroheline hoone.
8166.de: The square in front of the Cathedral (Toomkirik) with lime trees, whose crowns are cut off by the upper edge of the picture, dark shadows from the trees on the pinkish-toned square. Of the Cathedral only a corner is visible. Behind it the light green building of the Kreutzwald Library.

8170.d: Pargivaade tagapool olevate majadega. Esiplaanil raagus puude tumedad tüved, varjud langevad maapinnale. Puude taga kraavi kaldal erksavärvilised majad, kuurid õrnsinise taeva all.
8170.de: View of a park with houses behind. In the foreground the dark trunks of bare trees, shadows falling on the ground. Behind the trees, on the bank of a ditch, brightly coloured houses, sheds under a pale blue sky.

8171.d: Esiplaanil lagedal palgihunnikud. Tagapool rannaäärne puudesaluga, heleda katusega maja puude vahel. Vasakul puude vahelt paistab veekogu. Kõrge taevas.
8171.de: In the foreground on open ground, piles of logs. Beyond, a coastal grove with a house with a light-coloured roof among the trees. On the left a body of water is visible through the trees. High sky.

8193.d: Ees paremal valgel paberil viis roosades ja sinistes toonides kala. Vasakul pisut kaugemal suur roheline pudel. Selle ees taldrik lillkapsastega. Paremal taga kõrvits, millest tükk välja lõigatud ja suur arbuus. Foon sinine, vasakus nurgas ja ülaäärel tumelilla.
8193.de: In front, on the right, on white paper, five fish in pink and blue tones. On the left, a little further away, a large green bottle. In front of it a plate with cauliflowers. On the right, further back, a pumpkin with a piece cut out, and a large watermelon. The background is blue, dark purple in the left corner and along the upper edge.

8194.d: Kogu pildi pinnal ülalt alla tihedalt üksteise kõrval kujutatud demonstrantide rivi: esiplaanil valges pluusis ja pikas punakas sallis noor helepäine naine, käed rusikas, suu avatud; tema kõrval sinises ülikonnas mees samas poosis; nende taga vanem mees kaabus, noormehed, kaks punast lippu hoidvat meest; taga heledates rätikutes naisi ja mehi.
8194.de: Over the entire surface of the picture, from top to bottom, a row of demonstrators is depicted tightly side by side: in the foreground a young fair-haired woman in a white blouse and a long reddish scarf, hands clenched into fists, mouth open; beside her a man in a blue suit in the same pose; behind them an older man in a hat, young men, two men holding red flags; behind them women and men in light-coloured headscarves.

8195.d: Nurk kunstniku ateljeest akna all: ees kirjutuslaud, toolil kirju hommikumantel, aknalaual vaasides pintsleid, vasakul kapikesel lühter, laest ripub laevamudel. Paremal pilte, molbert.
8195.de: A corner of the artist's studio by the window: in front a writing desk, on the chair a colourful dressing gown, on the windowsill vases with brushes, on the left on a small cabinet a chandelier, from the ceiling hangs a ship model. On the right pictures, an easel.

8196.d: Noore, heledapäise tugitoolis istuva naise kolmveerandfiguur tumesinisel foonil. Keha poolpöördes vasakule, pea en face, seljas hall seelik ja helesinine pluus.
8196.de: Three-quarter figure of a young, fair-haired woman sitting in an armchair against a dark blue background. Body in half-turn to the left, head en face, wearing a grey skirt and a light blue blouse.

8197.d: Tugitoolis istuva heledanahalise naise täisfiguur, parem käsi nõjatab pead, vasak toolitoel. Tumesinisel foonil roheline kostüüm, valge krae, punane džemper, tool lillakas.
8197.de: Full figure of a fair-skinned woman sitting in an armchair, her right hand supporting her head, her left on the armrest. Green costume against a dark blue background, white collar, red jumper, purplish armchair.

8198.d: Tumeda kaabu ja prillidega mehe rinnafiguur otsevaates punasel foonil.
8198.de: Bust of a man with a dark hat and glasses in frontal view on a red background.

8208.d: Esiplaanil kaks kõhukat tumerohelist veinipudelit, parempoolne korvis. Tagapool kõrgemal alusel suur kaanega korv, kirsipunane draperii langeb pudelile, purk mahlaga ja sangadega vaskne kauss, erkkollasel taustal. Hoogne maalilaad.
8208.de: In the foreground, two bulbous, dark green wine bottles, the right one in a basket. Behind, on a higher stand, a large basket with a lid, cherry-red drapery falling onto a bottle, a jar with juice and a copper bowl with handles, against a bright yellow background. Vigorous painting style.

8212.d: Portreteeritu kujutatud ateljees töökitlis. Figuur on energiliselt ettepoole kallutunud, käed toetuvad lauale, paremas pintsel. Näo profiil joonistub teravalt heledale foonile. Seinal pilte, vasakpoolne Okase "Vaen".
8212.de: The sitter is depicted in the studio wearing a work smock. The figure is energetically leaning forward, hands resting on the table, a brush in the right hand. The profile of the face stands out sharply against the light background. Pictures on the wall, on the left Ott's "Vaen".

8215.de: Optical composition: 7 dark squares with a purple diagonal stripe, arranged regularly in 8 rows one below the other. In the bottom row, the second-to-last square, coloured chrome green, stands slightly askew in the row. The squares
